metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Ollie Hoodmood
records.biography_en: In The After-School Static, Ollie Hoodmood takes the role of dryly amused hoodie wearer. “I can hear you through the pause.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small handheld audio player and one loop of cable.

records.name: Jade Patchpin
records.biography_en: In The After-School Static, Jade Patchpin takes the role of intense sketchbook maker. “The page is still thinking.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small black sketchbook with a simple blank stitched patch and pencil.

records.name: Bert Boardlean
records.biography_en: In The After-School Static, Bert Boardlean takes the role of nervous skater. “It's faster when I carry it.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short rounded skateboard carried upright with small wheels, intact goo base visible.

records.name: Rory Playlist
records.biography_en: In The After-School Static, Rory Playlist takes the role of distracted music fan. “That's the chorus.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one pair of headphones held close at neck.

records.name: Tess Mirrorcheck
records.biography_en: In The After-School Static, Tess Mirrorcheck takes the role of skeptical style experimenter. “The mirror has notes.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small smooth pocket mirror and one colorful hair clip on a goo lobe.

records.name: Gus Strapzip
records.biography_en: In The After-School Static, Gus Strapzip takes the role of quiet after-school commuter. “I think I left my Monday in there.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: little backpack with a wide zipper pull held at chest.
